summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The ETRACS IFED Invest with the Fed TR Index ETN due September 15, 2061 (IFED) is an exchange-traded product that is based on the IFED Large-Cap US Equity index. The fund tracks a total return index of large-cap US equities that the issuer believes will benefit from the prevailing monetary environment. The fund uses multiple fundamental factors to select and weight securities for inclusion. IFED was launched on Sep 14, 2021 and is issued by ETRACS.
